item.title: BYD Ti7 Faces EU Ban Over Defender Design
item.dc:creator: Priya Verma
item.description: Tata Motors-owned Jaguar Land Rover has secured a preliminary injunction against BYD’s Ti7 SUV in the European Union. The District Court of The Hague ruled on November 20, 2026, that the SUV infringes JLR’s registered EU design for the Land Rover Defender. The decision restricts the Ti7’s sale and production within the EU while the wider legal dispute continues. BYD has rejected the finding.
